settings.heading: Details
settings.content:
• 100% vegan materials
  • High-quality rhinestones 
  • Suede lining
  • Height: 15cm, Width: 6.7cm, Length: 22cm
  • Extra rhinestones provided 
  • Comes with a short (height: 19cm) & long metal chain 
  • Long metal chain is adjustable

settings.heading: Sustainability Efforts
settings.content:
• All components of the product are made of cruelty-free materials.
  • Packaging is made from recyclables and contains no plastic. 
  • Most packaging and sampling-related waste during product development were reused in the manufacturing unit.

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Our orders are shipped within 5 working days from the purchase date. We estimate you will receive your order within 10 working days after the shipment date. We accept returns within 15 days of receiving the product. All shipping-related expenses of product return are to be borne by the sender. We will process the refund within 14 working days after receiving the product back.

settings.heading: Packaging
settings.content:
The product comes in our scented signature box packaging. Every item is protected by a velvet dust bag.
For gifts, you may request special gift packaging and a personalized message for the recipient. For this, please email at info@mirkashco.com.

settings.heading: Care Guide
settings.content: Recommended to store it in the original dust bag with inner stuffing. Please avoid scrubbing the crystal mesh with other belongings.
